CustomField.description: Calculates the number of days a Service Request has been open or the time taken to resolve it.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Request_Date__c), 0, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Resolution_Date__c)), Resolution_Date__c - Request_Date__c, NOW() - Request_Date__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows the number of days since the request was created, or the total days taken to resolve it.
CustomField.label: Days Open
